exclusions.name: Hospital administration or legal team
exclusions.why_safe: The committee charter states decisions are by majority vote of the three members; no other actors have a vote or veto.

exclusions.name: Patient or family input
exclusions.why_safe: The question asks only about the committee's approval; patient/family input is not part of the voting process.

exclusions.name: External regulatory bodies
exclusions.why_safe: The committee's decision is internal; external approvals are not part of this step.

uncertainties.meaning: Whether Tomas Lindqvist prepared and circulated an updated safety review incorporating the 10 March data before the 12 March meeting, given the timing constraints.
Whether the updated safety review was circulated to all members before the meeting, especially to Sister Doyle who was off-site and had no email access.
Whether Dr. Osei votes to approve, which depends on whether a current safety review is available and favorable.
Whether Dr. Patel votes to approve, which depends on whether a safety review is available and favorable.
Whether Sister Doyle votes to approve, which depends on whether a documented safety assessment has been provided to her.
Whether a majority of votes cast are in favor, which depends on the individual votes.
